capabilities: ADM-ANIM-1 (container and library metadata validation subset)
deviations: Validation covers a documented subset of ADM 1.0; it is not a conformance claim.
Smoke tests use synthetic fixtures; the separate uploaded-assets report covers the user-supplied files.
limitations: Cross-engine reference provenance and independently verified conformance are not established.
Rendering, texture/image decoding, animation evaluation, and IK solving are not implemented.
Full per-feature schema validation and JSON integer lexical-form checks are not yet implemented.
